value: The sorted berth's intent_berth text lost two characters to shell substitution at firing time: it reads "quoted verbatim in this node's  ('this component..." where it should read "in this node's `why`". The berth is an append-only record of what fired and is NOT edited; the authoritative text is this ticket's intent_berth field below. Recorded rather than silently corrected, because a berth and its ticket disagreeing by two characters with no note is the drift that teaches a later reader to trust neither.

value.a: THIS VOYAGE IS CHARTED BEFORE IT IS BUILT, AND THAT IS THE CORRECTION IT CARRIES. Its sibling constrain-floor-authors-and-provenance-is-measured was built first and cast afterwards, so its BUILDME crossing was refused by its own entry gate and it stands parked at TICKETME with working, proved, sealed code. The available fix there was to run /chart retroactively, which is plaster — berths written after the build satisfy the check without establishing the thing it checks for (Law 8's hollow pass). So the order is corrected going FORWARD, on this voyage, rather than laundered backward on that one.

THE MECHANICAL COLLISION WAS FOUND BEFORE BUILDING RATHER THAN AFTER, which is the whole argument for the preamble in one instance. The crowding-out probe armed hours earlier counts non-charter constraints as 'the ceiling's contribution'. The moment this floor emits kind:check, that arithmetic reads the floor's own bulk as evidence the ceiling is healthy — the instrument flattering the thing it measures. Its predicate must ASK the floor which kinds it produces rather than spelling 'charter' as a literal, which is the same reification lesson twice in one build.

SHIPPING THE PROBE FIX SEPARATELY WOULD LEAVE A WINDOW WHERE THE INSTRUMENT LIES IN THE BUILD'S FAVOUR. That is why it is not a child. A child that can pass while embodying the parent's failure is not a decomposition; it is a hole with a name.

DISCOVERY AND RUNNING CANNOT PROVE APART, which is why this has no children at all. A floor that discovers instruments and reports them without running them is exactly the briefing this ticket exists to replace — it would pass its own gate while being the defect.

THE REIFICATION WAS CAUGHT AT n=14 AND IT IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT ALMOST SHIPPED. CC arrived with five tidy categories (gates, measurements, precedent, rulings, contracts) and was one step from writing them into the code as a constant. Akien's third clause is the ruling against exactly that, and it is why the set is discovered from disk at fire time.

THE PROXY AND THE MEASURE ARE DIFFERENT AND THE WATCH USES THE MEASURE. The tool-call count is the proxy; the thing is which lookups stop. A floor that answers ten questions nobody asked while missing the one that was asked has moved the proxy and not the thing — which is why the WATCHME does not clear on packets getting bigger.

THE HYPOTHESIS THAT WAS KILLED IS THE ONE THAT PAID FOR ITSELF, AND IT NAMED ITS OWN DEATH IN ADVANCE. EMISSION's falsifier said: 'Falsified more seriously if it PASSES because the source is a string the judge resolves trivially without it naming the check — a source that resolves but does not identify is the laundered-provenance failure in a new place.' Measured at acceptance: judge_constrain returned [] on a packet whose check source had been swapped for the component DIRECTORY, a real path a resolver is happy with. So the expectation that spelling the source in the form the installed judge accepts is SUFFICIENT is false — the installed judge accepts a form it cannot distinguish. Seven hypotheses confirmed, one killed, and the killed one is the only one that changed the code. A chain whose hypotheses all confirm has not told you anything you did not already believe.

THE FIX WENT TO THIS MACHINE'S DOOR AND NOT TO THE SHARED JUDGE, AND THAT IS A BOUNDS DECISION RATHER THAN A DESIGN PREFERENCE. constraint_traces is the corpus-wide judge every constrain packet passes; making it require IDENTITY and not merely resolution would change what every other voyage's packets must satisfy, and constrain's stage-2 bounds put the inspector OUT. So every_check_names_a_discovered_instrument stands at constrain's own door, re-deriving the discovered set for the packet's own intent_ref and refusing a check source outside it. The corpus-wide question is real and it stands at Akien's gate unanswered: SHOULD a source that resolves but does not identify be refused everywhere? Widening the bounds to answer it here would have been the silent widening the chart exists to stop.

TWO DEFECTS WERE FOUND BY RUNNING THE CRITERIA AND ZERO BY READING THE CODE, AND BOTH WERE INVISIBLE TO EVERY PASSING TOOTH. The second is above; the first is that a proof path which vanished between discovery and the run came back {'verdict': 'red', 'how': 'run by the tester'} — python exits non-zero on a file it cannot open, so the VERDICT was defensible while the HOW was a record of truth telling a false story about a file that was never run (Law 7), sending a reader hunting for a failing assertion in a file that does not exist. Neither defect is exotic and neither would have been found by another pass over the source. The instrument is what found them, which is the criterion-with-an-instrument shape doing the exact work it was built for.

THE PROBE READS NOT CLEARED AT ARMING BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY A DATE SOMEONE TYPED. lookups_stop's population is derived from THIS TICKET'S OWN PROVED CROSSING, read out of the machine's history.json — so before the crossing landed the population was empty and no clearing clause could be satisfied, and after it landed the cutoff is exact and nobody has to remember to move it. Law 9 satisfied without a special case, and a learned value that never gets stranded in a human's head. Its third clearing clause is the one worth copying: at least one check must ever have been reported RED, because a report that has only said green is indistinguishable from a report that cannot say anything else — which is a constant this very component shipped once already.

WHAT THE WATCH CAN SEE IS CARRIAGE AND THE SUFFICIENT HALF IS DECLARED UNMEASURED. Akien's measure is that the LOOKUPS STOP. Nothing in this system counts a build's tool calls, so the observable is the discovered checks SURVIVING into the berthed packet: necessary, because checks that never reach the packet cannot have replaced a lookup, and not sufficient, because a full packet says nothing about whether the builder read it. The builder is Claude, which is Law 10's one standing exception. The gap is stated in the probe's carry, in the charter's filed edges and in the verdict artifact rather than left for a reader to discover — and the instrument that would close it is ticket the-builds-tool-calls-are-evidence-about-the-chart.

THE CRITERION'S CLAIM TEXT REACHED FURTHER THAN ITS OWN INSTRUMENT COULD AT A CROSSING, AND THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT THE VALIDATE LEG. Criterion 1 claims the lookups actually stop; its instrument can only read an armed probe plus the escalation clause. The verdict door takes pass|fail and a fail is a kick-back, so the claim was answered against what its instrument could measure at the crossing — the escalation clause did not fire — with the evidence field carrying the limit explicitly rather than the outcome field carrying a lie. The general shape, for the next chart: a criterion whose claim spans a WATCHME window needs its crossing-time half spelled IN THE CLAIM, or the verdict artifact is forced to choose between kicking back a finished build and overstating what was seen.
